## What

A `ClaudePasteDetection` dev-debug module on the existing **#101** Dev Debug Panel framework, built to diagnose **#90** (Claude prompt submit unreliable — detection falls behind under load). Pure instrumentation — **no changes to the submit path itself**.

Two panes:

## How

- `readRecentPasteSessions()` in `pasteDebugJournal.ts` + a `dev-debug:read-paste-events` IPC give the renderer-only module its main-process data (the journals were write-only at runtime).
- A pure `timeline.ts` reducer (`PasteDebugSession → SubmitLifecycle` + stats) holds all the digest logic — no React/IPC, keyed on the **real** event vocabulary (`keydown:enter`, `placeholder:appeared|timeout`, `write:submit-cr`, `submit:returned|throw`).
- The "stuck" signal is `placeholder:timeout` (the 10ms poller giving up) — exactly the failure mode #90 chases.

Refs #90, #101.
